name: PicVeda Optimizer
author: Sabir

sections.description:
PicVeda Optimizer is a lightweight image optimization plugin built for developers, WooCommerce stores, and performance-focused WordPress websites.

Unlike many image optimization plugins that rely on third-party APIs or cloud processing, PicVeda performs all optimization locally on your own server using native WordPress and PHP image functions.

The plugin focuses on performance, privacy, and SEO automation while maintaining compatibility with standard WordPress workflows.

Key Features

  • 100% Local Processing
    Optimize images directly on your own server without external APIs, monthly limits, remote processing, or third-party data transfers.

  • Context-Aware SEO Automation
    Automatically generate image ALT text and image titles based on the post or page content where the image is attached.

  • Smart Skipping Engine
    Prevents unnecessary optimization of tiny decorative assets such as icons, logos, emojis, and very small images to help preserve image quality.

  • Automatic WebP Conversion
    Generate WebP versions of uploaded JPEG and PNG images to improve loading performance and reduce bandwidth usage.

  • Bulk Optimization Tool
    Optimize existing Media Library images using the built-in bulk processing system.

  • WooCommerce Ready
    Supports WooCommerce product images and generated thumbnail sizes.

  • Privacy Focused
    No external services, remote servers, tracking systems, or API keys required.

  • Performance Focused
    Designed to work with minimal overhead and efficient background processing.

  • Translation Ready
    Includes translation support and language template files.

Included Features

  • Automatic image compression on upload
  • WebP conversion for JPEG and PNG images
  • SEO-friendly image ALT text generation
  • SEO-friendly image title generation
  • Bulk optimization for existing media library images
  • Skip list support for selected image filenames
  • WooCommerce image support
  • Lightweight and modular plugin structure
  • WordPress coding standards friendly architecture
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress Plugins menu
  3. Open the PicVeda Optimizer settings page
  4. Configure your optimization preferences
  5. Upload new images or run bulk optimization for existing images
sections.faq:
Does PicVeda support existing images?

Yes. You can optimize existing Media Library images using the built-in bulk optimization tool.

Does the plugin require an API key?

No. PicVeda performs all processing locally on your server without external APIs or cloud services.

Does the plugin support WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce product images and generated thumbnails are supported.

Does the plugin remove original images?

No. Original JPEG and PNG files are preserved. WebP versions are created as additional image files.

Can specific images be skipped?

Yes. You can exclude specific image filenames such as logos or icons from optimization and WebP conversion.

Does the plugin automatically generate ALT text?

Yes. ALT text and image titles can be generated automatically using context-aware logic based on the attached post or page content.

Why are optimized images not visible immediately?

Caching systems may delay visible changes. Clear your site cache and browser cache after optimization.

Is the plugin compatible with caching plugins and CDNs?

The plugin is designed to work alongside standard WordPress caching plugins and CDN services.
